newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP official says Japan should abolish stock tax.
newsitem.headline: LDP official says Japan should abolish stock tax.

text.p: A member of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party's (LDP) tax research council told Reuters on Wednesday that Japan should abolish the securities transaction tax as early as 1998.
The official, who did not want to be identified, added however that this was his personal view and did not necessarily represent the party's position.

"Given our policy task of carrying out "Big Bang" financial reforms and putting Japan's securities market on an international footing, we must consider abolishing the securities transaction tax because there are no such tax systems abroad," the official said.
He also said that many LDP tax council members want to start discussing how to carry out new tax reforms earlier than the autumn when the council usually starts such debate.
"After the general elections last year, the council has new members but...we still have many issues to discuss," he said.
"Many council members think the council should start its activities earlier than autumn, when it usually starts discussions," he said.
